contactComposer.surface: Native dialog bottom sheet, 760px max width, 94dvh max height, 20px top corners, neutral canvas and orchid primary action
contactComposer.motion: Clipped opaque shell rises 64px in 520ms; no SVG or inner animation; simple 10px paper lip. Independent height-constrained form scroller with stable gutter. Cancellable 180ms close; reduced motion immediate; CTA arrow only 3px
contactComposer.attachmentNotice: No standing reminder. Files change primary action to Open text in email app; attach-again notice appears only on text handoff.
contactComposer.state: Memory-only subject/message/files preserved on close and locale/theme changes; untouched defaults translate
contactComposer.handoff: Encoded native mailto; files require reattachment. Optional capability-gated Web Share files with destination caveat; no upload/send
contactComposer.fallbacks: NoJS mailto; long URL copy/paste with explanation; clipboard failure selectable text; share cancellation silent, failure actionable

primaryActionMotion.thesis: Welcoming responsive invitation from independent engineers: precise yet playful
primaryActionMotion.shape: Unified orchid surface, 4px corners; unboxed 28px arrow; 60px minimum target; stable label
primaryActionMotion.feedback: Contained entry-point fill and diagonal arrow launch 420ms; exit 180ms; arrow pointer response bounded ±4px/±3px; press translate 5px scale .88; cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)
primaryActionMotion.accessibility: Native localized mailto draft, visible localized email-app helper, keyboard finished state, touch press, reduced-motion immediate color without transforms/tracking; English noJS draft
primaryActionMotion.implementation: assets/cta.js: fine-hover pointer feedback batched by requestAnimationFrame; canceled/reset on leave/cancel/blur or reduced motion; no activation interception. preferences.js encodes localized email subject/body.

language.detection: Primary navigator.language el or el-* selects Greek; otherwise English

websitePreferences.accentUsage: Primary contact CTA, focus/selection, and small founder signoff. Headings, other links, list markers, secondary copy, rules and scrollbar are neutral; light portrait outline #D5D3CE, dark transparent.
websitePreferences.scope: Website styles only; canonical brand/theme assets unchanged
websitePreferences.fallback: English static HTML; system-aware CSS; preference buttons hidden without JavaScript
websitePreferences.bootstrap: Synchronous preferences.js before styles; safe localStorage access
websitePreferences.typography: Existing self-hosted Source Sans 3 regular and semibold include Greek
websitePreferences.controls: Header: wordmark left, native EN / ΕΛ and sun/moon buttons right; no section navigation. Current language underlined, localized accessible target names and tooltips; 16px type, 44px targets. Localized Use system defaults action shown only with overrides resets both and returns focus to theme; extra header padding accommodates reset.

rules.name: The Meaningful Accent Rule
rules.body: Reserve orchid for the primary contact CTA, focus/selection and small founder signoff; use neutrals for headings, secondary links, supporting text and rules.

rules.name: The One Text Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Source Sans 3 throughout the interface; the logo is supplied artwork.

dos: Preserve both studio portrait sources and earlier originals, plus brand artwork.
Use readable contrast and local fonts.
Allow wrapping and collapse paired columns on mobile.
donts: Do not fabricate testimonials, project images or metrics.
Do not add gradients, glow or generic card grids.
